spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land-surface reanalysis coverage; users may subset any basin, station network, ecological region or other land study area.

analytical_capabilities: Analyse monthly precipitation, snowfall, evapotranspiration, runoff and air-temperature fields

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Monthly ERA5-Land land-surface meteorological and hydrological fields; units depend on the selected band (for example mm for accumulated precipitation/runoff and °C or K for temperature).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR and select the band matching the research question. Keep accumulated bands (for example total_precipitation_sum and runoff_sum) distinct from monthly mean bands. If starting from the hourly collection, aggregate explicitly to monthly before analysis.

current_task_binding.data_source: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), distributed through Google Earth Engine and the Copernicus Climate Data Store

observation_identity_contract.physical_object: monthly land-surface meteorological and soil-state fields
observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: monthly statistics derived from ERA5-Land meteorological or soil variables
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: CDS/GEE archive, release, reprojection, resampling or monthly aggregation performed from ERA5-Land hourly/daily fields
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis, another land reanalysis or ERA5-Land use with no monthly research input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: Admit ERA5-Land monthly aggregated fields distributed through the Copernicus Climate Data Store or the Google Earth Engine collection ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR. ERA5-Land hourly or daily fields explicitly aggregated to monthly variables are also admitted when the monthly output is the operational research input. ERA5, ERA5-Land hourly-only analyses without monthly processing, MERRA-2 and other land reanalyses are excluded.
